title: Task
description: A task as the API returns it (TK §7, data model). Dates and times are floating local values (ADR-006).

start_date.description: The day the user plans to work on the task. Optional until the API returns it (#124 follow-up).

due_time.description: The deadline time on the due date. Optional until the API returns it (#124 follow-up).

repeat.description: Frequency enum. A non-null repeat_rule must have the same FREQ.

repeat_anchor.description: Original local date of the series, maintained by the server. Moving one occurrence preserves it. Current task responses include it; older embedded note snapshots may omit it.

repeat_rule.description: Nullable calendar RRULE. FREQ is first and matches repeat. Supported parts: FREQ, INTERVAL (1-999), BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, WKST, COUNT (1-10000) and UNTIL; COUNT and UNTIL are exclusive. Backend validation checks full rule semantics. Null uses legacy enum-only recurrence. Human-readable descriptions are formatted by the frontend, not returned by the API.
